title: Director Activation Lead, GOC
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Role Summary and Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with client and regional teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to elevate the operational quality of media execution and strengthen WPP Media’s position as a trusted strategic marketing and activation partner. We are looking for a Director, Activation Lead who will:

• Partner with senior client and agency leads to translate overarching communications strategies into flawless, multi-channel media activation and execution plans.

• Own the activation foundation of client plans , from channel architecture, taxonomy, and technology setup through briefing, campaign launch, real-time optimization, QA governance, and post-campaign performance assessment.

• Translate strategic target definitions, consumer journeys, and media plans into actionable operational guidelines, bidding strategies, and high-performing channel execution.

• Define and raise the standard of operational excellence by applying global best practices, ad tech innovations, automation tools, and rigorous quality control frameworks across accounts.

• Build credible relationships with key client, agency, ad tech, and platform stakeholders, representing Activation in integrated agency initiatives and collaborative working sessions.

• Ensure strategic intent remains integrated throughout delivery ; identify execution risks, mobilize technical teams, and course-correct live campaigns to protect media efficiency and business impact.

• Lead, inspire, coach, and develop Activation talent , establishing clear expectations, driving technical mastery, and supporting team members in building the skills required for long-term growth.

Responsibilities

• Cross-Channel Activation Strategy: Lead and oversee end-to-end media activation strategies across Digital, Programmatic, Paid Search, Paid Social, and emerging channels, ensuring operational alignment with strategic client goals and regional standards.

• Operational Excellence & Governance: Define, implement, and maintain standardized activation workflows, QA frameworks, and best practices across GOC operations to guarantee flawless campaign setup, pacing, and execution quality.

• Campaign Management & Optimization: Oversee multi-channel campaign lifecycle execution, driving real-time performance optimization, bid management, and troubleshooting to meet and exceed client KPIs.

• Budget Oversight & Financial Governance: Manage and monitor large-scale media budgets across markets, ensuring accurate spend pacing, cost-efficiency, and optimal return on ad spend (ROAS).

• Data, Tech & Analytics Integration: Collaborate with technology and analytics teams to integrate ad tech stacks (DSPs, ad servers, brand safety tools) and reporting frameworks into daily activation processes.

• Client & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the senior GOC activation point of contact for regional client leads and agency partners across North America, Europe, and Asia, presenting execution roadmaps, performance results, and operational insights.

• End-to-End Service Alignment: Partner closely with Strategic Planning and Investment teams to ensure strategic recommendations are seamlessly translated into actionable, scalable activation plans from brief to final reporting.

title: 2027 Summer Intern, Program Operations (MO, AK, IL, TX)
description:
We are hiring Program Operations, Program Delivery and Program Outreach Interns who support the planning, execution, and monitoring of energy efficiency programs within  ICF ’s Utility, Programs and Services division. These roles provide hands-on experience in program operations and offers a valuable opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a professional setting. 

As an intern, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute to the development of high-quality products and services, and gain exposure to major projects and client interactions. This experience is designed to help build foundational skills in project management, communication, and teamwork, while deepening your understanding of energy-efficient technologies and utility-sponsored programs. 

This is an entry-level, 10-week, full time internship that begins in early June 2027. Pay is expected to be $23 per hour for undergraduate students and $28 per hour for graduate students. These roles can be remote, with preference for those near Houston, TX; Missouri; Arkansas; Chicago, IL. At this time, we are unable to provide relocation nor housing assistance.  

As a Program Operations intern, you will:

• Coordinate and support the execution of program activities, events, tasks, and deliverables.

• Conduct research and analyze data on market trends, customer segments, competitive landscapes, and energy efficiency equipment to support program planning and decision-making.

• Evaluate market potential, program growth opportunities, and distributor, contractor, and trade ally networks.

• Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Engineering, and other team members to develop aligned outreach, sales, customer targeting, decarbonization, equity and affordability, lead generation, and value proposition strategies.

• Prepare and maintain reports, schedules, meeting minutes, and other program documentation.

• Summarize findings and present actionable recommendations that support data-driven decisions and the development of accurate, timely, high-quality products and services.

• Provide administrative and communications support, including coordinating meetings and helping teams complete priorities on time.

As a Program Delivery Intern, you will:

• Support the Program Delivery team by developing client presentations and communicating key program results to internal and external stakeholders.

• Identify and develop program opportunities that advance clients’ clean energy goals.

• Review program processes and recommend opportunities to improve efficiency and delivery.

• Coordinate with program implementation teams and cross-functional partners, including Marketing, IT, and Customer Care.

• Engage participating service providers to gather information and identify opportunities for program improvement, depending on the role.

• Prepare and review technical specifications and calculations for energy efficiency measures and projects, depending on the required skill set.

As a Program Outreach Intern, you will:

• Provide support for field-based staff and the network of participating Trade Allies

• Support communications with participating contractors, customers, and consultants.

• Clarify and resolve/escalate customer/contractor concerns related to program participation as necessary.

• Collaborate with regional and national teams to provide national cohesiveness and bring efficiency & best practices to your client’s programs.

• Support and track contractor enrollment in programs.

• Assist technical teams to ensure QA/QC standards for the program are met.
Individuals with a focus-area preference (Operations, Delivery or Outreach) should note such on their cover letter or resume, otherwise, applicants may be considered for any of the above teams.
Basic Qualifications

title: Senior Account Manager, Retail
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, we’re looking for a Senior Account Manager in our retail team who will play a key role in supporting our biggest retail partners and helping them succeed on our platform. If you’re eager to learn, enjoy working with different teams, and want to be part of shaping the shopping experience of the future, this could be the role for you.

Part of the DoorDash team, we’re building a global logistics platform that can deliver (almost) everything in your city, to your door in minutes. Today, our products are used by 55+ million registered users who can now order from 200,000+ restaurants and retail stores across 30+ countries around the world.

Together, we’ve helped big brands, local stores and neighborhood restaurants do over €15 billion’s worth of business through our platform. We’re constantly launching new cities and products, so there are always new opportunities to expand your skills and progress your career. 

As our new Senior Account Manager you’ll manage and develop a portfolio of retail partners, focusing on building strong relationships, using data to drive performance, and delivering results for Wolt, our partners, and our customers.

What you’ll be doing

• Own and develop the partnerships with some of our largest and most important accounts

• Build strong senior stakeholder relationships and act as a trusted advisor to drive long-term growth

• Lead quarterly business reviews to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and define joint growth plans

• Understand merchant priorities and business challenges, translate them into clear actions, and co-create solutions that deliver measurable impact

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

THE ROLE

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

- Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

- Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

- Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

- Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics,

Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks.

Our team brings together product engineering, design, and research to turn frontier model capabilities into useful everyday experiences. Engineers help shape both the product and the systems behind it, from early prototypes through launch and iteration.

We are looking for Senior and Staff Full Stack Software Engineers to build Dots product experiences from the interface through the services that power them. You will help define how people delegate tasks to personal agents, follow their progress, and collaborate with them over time. This role combines hands-on product development with the systems work needed to make persistent, asynchronous agent experiences reliable.

In this role, you will:

- Build and launch features across web interfaces, APIs, backend services, and data models.

- Create workflows for task creation, progress updates, agent feedback, and results that remain coherent across sessions and devices.

- Translate emerging model capabilities into product prototypes with research, product, and design partners.

- Own projects from early exploration through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration based on user feedback.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have significant experience building and shipping products across frontend and backend systems.

- Can move comfortably between user interfaces, service design, APIs, and data modeling.

- Bring strong product instincts and care about making complex capabilities understandable to users.

- Have taken ambiguous ideas from concept to production and made practical tradeoffs between iteration speed and long-term maintainability.

- Understand asynchronous workflows and can reason about state, consistency, and failure across system boundaries.

- Collaborate effectively with design, product, research, and engineering partners.

- Have owned complex engineering projects and helped other engineers make sound technical decisions.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. title: Director, Manufacturing (China) | 制造总监 (中国)
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products - including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub - brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

We're looking for a Director, Manufacturing to be our first Greenlight team member in China and our eyes, ears, and voice on the factory floor. You'll own our ODM relationships end to end, from day-to-day build execution and quality gates to sourcing the partners who will build what comes next. You'll have real authority: you can stop a shipment, reject a lot, demand a corrective action, and shape which suppliers we bet on. Reporting to our VP, Business Operations, you'll partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Quality, Finance, and Supply Chain in the US, and spend roughly 15-30% of your time on-site with suppliers across the Greater Bay Area.
Good to know: this role is employed through Greenlight's Employer of Record (EOR) partner in China, and Greenlight directs the day-to-day work. Contracts, POs, and supplier payments are signed by our US entity - you recommend and negotiate, we sign. It's a deliberate setup for a first hire in a new market.

Our stance on salaries:
Greenlight provides a competitive compensation package with a market-based approach to pay and will vary depending on your location, experience and skill set. Greenlight conducts continuous compensation evaluations across departments and geographies to ensure we are keeping our pay current and competitive.
 
The estimated base pay range for this position is: ¥500,000 - ¥750,000
 

Who we are:
It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply. 
 
Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.
 
Greenlight is committed to an inclusive work environment and interview experience. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in our hiring process, please reach out to your recruiter directly or email accomodations@greenlight.me.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
We’re a ~40 person company building the OAuth/OpenID Connect platform that large digital banks and regulated industries run their identity on. Our stack is Java on Google Cloud, delivered as a shared multi-tenant service, dedicated single-tenant clusters, and a self-managed product customers run themselves.
This is a hands-on builder role, not a management or pure-compliance role. You’ll build our security program from the ground up: writing the policies, shipping code fixes, wiring detection into GCP, and setting the practices the rest of engineering follows. You’ll lean on AI to move fast, researching how the best companies do this, drafting policies, reviewing code, and hunting vulnerabilities at a scale a lean team otherwise couldn’t reach.
What you'll do

• Stand up our vulnerability management program end to end: intake, triage, severity, remediation targets, security advisories, and coordinated disclosure, across both our managed and self-managed deployment models.

• Build our product security incident response (PSIRT): on-call, playbooks, and AI-assisted triage that turns High/Critical CVEs into paged incidents automatically.

• Work hands-on in the codebase, contributing security fixes to our Java platform and raising the bar on secure coding, secrets and key management, and hardening.

• Build proactive detection and response in GCP: alerts, monitoring, and automation where it pays off.

• Integrate security into CI/CD and IaC: dependency and container scanning, Terraform checks.

• Own our external security posture: security.txt, a security contact, a public trust page, and a security white paper.

• Get ahead of frontier-AI offensive tooling (the Mythos class of AI-discovered zero-days) by pointing AI agents at our own code before someone else does.

• Partner with platform engineers on security-relevant architecture and lead its security dimension.

• Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls pragmatically alongside engineering, without the role becoming audit admin.

What we're looking for

• A hands-on security engineer who codes. You’re comfortable reading and writing code (Java, Go a strong plus), Terraform, and GCP configs, not just reviewing others’ work.

• Strong application security foundation: secure coding, vulnerability management, security in CI/CD.

• Cloud security depth on GCP, IAM, Kubernetes, infrastructure hardening.

• Incident response experience: investigations, detection tooling, and clear communication with customers or regulators.

• You’re energized by owning the whole spectrum at a small company rather than going narrow at a large one.

• Bonus: OAuth/OIDC, FAPI, or identity-security background; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 exposure.

Why Join Us

• Own security for a platform used by large financial and regulated customers

• Work closely with founders, engineering, and customers

• Modern, cloud-native environment without unnecessary overhead

• Competitive pay and flexibility

APIs powering chapter management, forum operations, event discovery, and role-based data access across YPO 's global regional structure.

• Every API decision must reinforce member trust through privacy-first architecture, consent enforcement, and transparent data usage.

• Ensure every API response includes provenance and explanation metadata, so agent reasoning is always surfaceable to the member.

title: GTM Strategy & Operations, APAC Lead
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a GTM Strategy & Operations Lead, you will be a founding member of our GTM Strategy & Operations team, embedded as the strategic partner to the sales leaders running our APAC sales organization.

You will own segment performance alongside those leaders: the strategy behind the number, the operating cadence and tactics that drive it, and the analysis that explains what is working and what is not. From forecasting and pipeline management to territory design, capacity planning, quota and incentive structures, and go-to-market strategy, you will touch nearly every lever that makes a sales organization perform.

This is a high-visibility seat at the center of the business. The role is a direct path to a deep understanding of commercial strategy and operational excellence in a high-growth environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Partner directly with Enterprise, Mid-Market and BDR leadership to define segment strategy, growth priorities, and execution plans.

- Translate company-level goals into segment targets, operating plans, and measurable KPIs.

- Own the forecast for your segments: run the cadence, pressure-test the calls, and give leadership a defensible view of where the quarter lands.

- Lead high-impact analyses that inform critical decisions across pipeline health, conversion, capacity planning, segmentation, incentive design, and headcount investment.

- Build the financial and operating models used to evaluate trade-offs and quantify the impact of GTM decisions.

- Own territory and account coverage design, quota setting, and the mechanics that make both defensible to reps and leadership.

- Design and run the core business cadences that create accountability: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and QBRs.

- Build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline generation.

- Establish the metrics that distinguish top performers, diagnose the root causes of underperformance, and scale what works across the team.

- Improve Salesforce and the surrounding GTM stack so data integrity, workflow efficiency, and reporting keep pace with the business.

- Project-manage cross-functional initiatives spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Engineering & Product, Finance, Recruiting, and Operations.

- Find novel ways to use Factory droids to automate the reporting, analysis, and deal support work that would otherwise consume the team.

- Roll up your sleeves on immediate problems while building the long-term infrastructure, and present clear, structured recommendations to senior leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of professional experience, ideally in consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or a high-growth startup.

- Strong analytical skills: You go deep on data and structure analyses quickly to answer the business question at hand. You know the data underneath your work, including where it comes from, how it's built, and where it falls short. You can defend your numbers and have a point of view.

- Ownership: You take initiative, drive problems to the finish, bring in the right people at the right time, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome.

title: Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA

We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We are seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.

Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.

What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta:

- Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts

- Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

- Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

- Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

- Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

- Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

- Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment

- Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region

How to be successful in this role:

- Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

- Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

- Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

- Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

- Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

- Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

- Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

- Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

- Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

- Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

About RAINN

Since 1994, RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) has helped millions of people affected by sexual violence and we're just getting started. As the nation's largest anti-sexual violence organization and operator of the National Sexual Assault Hotline (1-800-656-HOPE), we lead the fight against sexual violence by expanding prevention, ensuring justice, and providing healing to create safer communities.
Our mission is to stop sexual violence by supporting survivors, holding perpetrators accountable, and creating safer communities and we do it through three pillars:
Prevention - Educating the public and inspiring action through media, entertainment, and direct outreach
Justice - Leading bipartisan policy campaigns and working to hold every offender accountable

title: Strategic Account Director – PSU/Government
description:

About the Role:
Kong is the AI Connectivity Company. We build the infrastructure that lets enterprises govern APIs and AI traffic at scale - and that infrastructure is becoming critical to how India's government and public sector modernize their systems.
We're hiring an Account Executive to own a defined patch of PSU (Public Sector Undertaking) and Government accounts across India. You'll work the full government buying cycle - tenders, GeM listings, System Integrator relationships, empanelment - to bring Kong 's platform into major public-sector modernization programs.
This role is based in Delhi and reports to a Country Manager.
What You'll Do:

• Own the sales cycle, government-style. Lead deals from first conversation through RFP response, technical and financial bid submission, and contract award. Track PQ (pre-qualification) criteria, EMD requirements, and L1 bidding dynamics. Keep your pipeline accurate to what's actually documented in the tender process - not what looks good in a forecast.

• Work the ecosystem, not just the account. Government and PSU deals rarely close direct. Build real relationships with the System Integrators (SIs) and OEM partners who carry the technical bid, and make sure Kong is positioned - and empanelled - before the tender drops.

• Navigate multiple stakeholders. IT Secretaries, CTOs and CIOs at PSUs, nodal officers, procurement and finance committees - each has different priorities and a different definition of "done." Map them accurately and plan around all of them.

• Build account plans for your patch. Identify which departments and PSUs are actively modernizing, where their budget cycles sit, and what a realistic path to close looks like. Then execute against it.

• Get fluent in the platform and the landscape. Know Kong 's API and AI governance platform well enough to defend it in a technical bid, and know where competitors are already empanelled.

• Meet your number. Consistently hit quota. Government cycles are long - consistency across quarters matters more than any single deal.

• Bring in the rest of Kong early. Loop in sales engineering, legal, and the channel team before compliance and certification requirements (STQC, data residency, MeitY empanelment) become a bottleneck late in the deal.

• Travel. Expect real time in government offices and PSU sites across India. This is a relationship business, and relationships in this sector are built in person.

What You'll Bring:

• 8-12 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology sales, with direct experience selling into Indian government departments or PSUs. This isn't optional - the public-sector buying process is different enough that generalist enterprise experience alone won't carry you.

• A track record of consistently hitting quota (typically in the ₹2-5 Cr / $300K-$750K range) sold through longer, multi-stakeholder government cycles.

• Working knowledge of India's government tendering lifecycle - GeM, RFP/RFI processes, technical and financial bids, PQ criteria, EMD - and how empanelment with bodies like MeitY or NIC actually works in practice.

• Established relationships with System Integrators and OEM partners active in India's public-sector technology space.

• Process discipline and patience. Government deals move on their own timeline. You bring structure to that timeline - you don't try to force it.

• Executive presence with senior government officials and PSU leadership , along with the judgment to know when to push and when to wait.

• Ownership with collaboration. You run your patch, but you know when to pull in your manager, sales engineering, or a partner. In the public sector, this isn't a solo sport.

title: Talent Coordinator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE TALENT ACQUISITION TEAM

- Deploy AI across the entire funnel. Use the latest models in every part of talent ops to find the best people in the world faster than any team has before. You won't bolt AI onto old processes; you'll rebuild recruiting around it.

- Treat talent as the critical path. Every role we can't fill slows the whole company down. We need to figure out how to move faster than everyone else in market without ever dropping the bar; one wrong hire costs more than a slow one.

- Build a brand the best want to join. Make Fluidstack a name top talent seeks out, not one we have to chase. You'll shape how the world's best engineers and operators hear about us, and why they say yes.

 

ROLE SCOPE

- Maintain data integrity: own accurate, up-to-date candidate records and workflow tracking in the ATS.

- Support the TA team operationally, partnering with Partners and Sourcers on the tasks that keep pipelines healthy and hiring moving.

- Spot friction in the process, flag it, and help build better workflows, leaving every system better than you found it.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Sourcing & chasse

• Tu mènes les préqualifications téléphoniques pour les profils chassés afin de valider les critères clés : disponibilité, motivations, compétences de base, adéquation avec le poste.

• Tu veilles à ce qu'aucun candidat ne reste sans nouvelles : l'expérience candidat est l’un des piliers de Golden Hire .

Reporting & visibilité

• Tu partages proactivement tes actions : le Responsable Recrutement est informé de l'avancement de la chasse au fil de la semaine (profils contactés, réponses reçues, entretiens planifiés).

title: Principal Platform Engineer, DevOps and Deployment (Regulated AI Software)
description:
ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite. We combine mechanistic modeling, Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), with software and training to support Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Next-Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA) for pharmaceutical, chemical, and academic partners worldwide. Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.
We are building a platform where AI agents help scientists set up regulated modeling analyses, and fixed, versioned procedures run them. This job is about the engine room: the compute core, the release pipeline and the operations.

About the role
You make sure our analyses can be reproduced, shipped to clients and checked later. You own the compute core, the release pipeline, deployment into client environments, and the metering and provenance behind every result. The AI layer has its own lead and team; you build what they run on. The Quality Manager sets the standards, you implement them. You report to the CEO.
Key Responsibilities

• Make the scientific compute core deterministic: pinned R, Python and solver toolchains, content-addressed container images with a software bill of materials, and tests that prove byte-identical re-execution on a reference platform and tolerance-bounded re-execution across platforms.

• Build the services the AI layer runs on: isolated executors per client without network access, usage metering per call, the signed record and the certificate behind every result. You build the policy engine and the tool router together with the AI lead.

• Expose the platform as a versioned API and as tools for AI agents with one shared contract, and ship the reproducibility package that re-executes a run outside the platform.

• Run the evaluation pipeline in continuous integration: conformance tests against reference case sets, re-execution tests, regression tests, results stored per procedure version.

• Own release engineering and operations: CI/CD pipelines, signed and content-addressed releases, scripted installation qualification, environment management (hosted, in a client tenant, later offline), monitoring, incident handling and the operating model the deployment engineer runs.

• Implement the technical controls behind the information security and AI management standards the Quality Manager owns.

What you bring

• At least five years of platform, infrastructure or backend engineering with senior ownership of a production system.

• Reproducible builds and execution in practice: dependency pinning, artifact hashing, immutable versioning, supply chain integrity. Hermetic build systems are a strong plus.

• Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator, monitoring, and release management for environments you don’t fully control.

• API design where the schema was a contract with external consumers, including versioning and deprecation in practice.

• Security engineering for multi-tenant systems: isolation, secrets, authorization, and awareness of the risks of language-model-driven systems. Exposure to GxP or equivalent regulated software is valuable; interest in acquiring it is required.

What's in store for you

The dynamic team behind ESQlabs unites people with different backgrounds, spanning disciplines like pharmaceutical sciences, physics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science, and software engineering. Our trust in each other, our open-mindedness, and our constant quest for excellence and innovation unite us. We value flat hierarchies, where everyone can contribute ideas and expertise to develop the best product. We are passionate, always willing to broaden our horizons, and love our start-up culture.

description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB) is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.  

Position Summary

Metrea is actively recruiting current and qualified Contract KC-135 Pilots-in-Command (PIC’s) and Second in Command (SIC’s) to execute high tempo, precision driven air to air refueling missions aboard our KC/C-135 fleet. This is not just another contract; it’s a chance to lead strategic operations that shape global airpower.  If you’re ready to fuel the fight, lead from the front, and fly with purpose this may be your next mission!

Contract Highlights:

• Flexible short- and long-term deployments supporting U.S. and allied forces are available and extended rotations of 45-90 days, delivering critical refueling support in a high-demand regional environments in India

• Competitive daily rates and mission incentives

• All travel, lodging, and mission logistics covered

• Flexible scheduling and rotation options

• Work alongside elite crews in high-impact missions that shape global readiness

What You'll Do

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. Lyra is committed to addressing urgent and costly mental health needs with specialized support where it’s needed most. Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers diagnostic evaluations, caregiver training, and tailored support for ADHD, autism, learning differences, and other neurodiversity-related needs. We are looking for a full-timeNeurodiversity Navigator who is passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care to join our clinical team. This remote position reports to the Supervisor, Neurodiversity Navigation. 
 
As a Neurodiversity Navigator, you’ll be doing the important and meaningful work of supporting individuals as they navigate through the complex landscape of care for neurodiversity. You will provide critical psychoeducation on topics like early intervention services, behavioral strategies to address neurodiversity-related needs, navigating a diagnosis, and how to advocate for school, government and workplace accommodation services. Additionally, you will help connect clients to high-quality, evidence-based diagnosticians, services, and providers, depending on their needs. This position does not involve in-person services or therapy, but rather provides support to individuals and families related to neurodiversity via phone, video conference, and/or email.

title: Account Manager
description:
Description
Physical AI for Mission Critical Operations.
Percepto is the Physical AI platform for continuous infrastructure visibility. Our mission is to give asset operators one certainty: nothing changes without them knowing first.
We orchestrate autonomous and remote data capture across drones, sensors and other systems into one continuously verified, always-current picture of every asset an operator is accountable for. Periodic inspections force operators to assume everything is fine; continuous visibility replaces assumption with certainty.
Our solutions:
• Axion - the Physical AI platform: a continuously verified model of every asset, the AI and the workflow.
• AIM - the autonomous mission control for every Percepto and third party drone and docking station.
• Ranger - the autonomous capture layer that keeps AIM's picture current without sending people into the field.
• Harbor - the autonomous station that lets Ranger fly continuously with no one on site.
Percepto holds a nationwide FAA Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) waiver, supports EPA-aligned methane inspection workflows, and is trusted by Fortune 500 energy operators across oil and gas, electric utilities, solar and heavy industry.
Percepto is consolidating its engineering, manufacturing, assembly and remote operations center in the United States: built for American infrastructure, and increasingly built here. This role sits at the center of how we tell that story to the US market.
The role
Summary. Owns the day-to-day relationship, retention and QBR/EBR cadence for a book of smaller customer accounts, and supports the account's AE on expansion.
Responsibilities

• Keep every account in the book flat or growing in ARR through the year

• Schedule and complete a QBR each quarter and an EBR twice a year for every account

• Be the customer's first point of contact; coordinate Support & Ops to meet SLAs

• Spot expansion signals (new sites, use cases, drones, AIM) and bring in the account's AE

• 3+ years in account management or customer success for B2B technology

• Clear communicator with operations and site-level customer teams

• Experience in energy, utilities or industrial markets preferred

Why join Percepto

• Shape the voice of a Physical AI company as it builds its future in the US.

• Work on technology that keeps critical energy infrastructure safer and more reliable, and takes people out of harm's way.

• Tell the story of a platform with real proof behind it: a nationwide FAA BVLOS waiver and Fortune 500 customers.

• High ownership and visibility, working directly with the CMO and executive team.

• Benefits: medical/dental/vision with company premium allowance, Health Reimbursement & Savings Accounts, 401(K) Plan

• Paid Time Off

• Great team and supportive environment

• Career growth and opportunity

Equal opportunity
Percepto is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.

title: Business Technology Consultant
description:
MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for two Business Technology Consultants to join our growing IT team.

The Role in Two Bullet Points

• Take business problems from a vague request to a working, adopted solution.

• Hands-on systems, automation and AI delivery across Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Revenue, Finance, Royalties and Marketing.

Let's be honest!
This is a small team with big aspirations, and a rare chance to reshape how a growing business runs on technology. It is also a role where you are expected to own the outcome, not just the idea.

This role is not for: people who prefer to write the requirement and hand it to someone else to build; specialists who want to work on one platform only; or anyone who needs a project manager to tell them what to do next. If you need a bit more information...
We are hiring two complementary generalists who get things done. Each has broad practical technology skills and end-to-end ownership: work out what is really needed, choose the simplest thing that will work, configure or build it, and make sure people use it. Some weeks that means automating a manual process; others it means connecting two systems, fixing a report nobody trusts, or running a small project end to end. Specialist partners handle the deep platform work. Your job is to make sure the work actually ships.
What you will do

• Shape problems: map how things work today, find the real requirement and challenge it where it needs challenging.

• Choose solutions: configuration, an existing tool, an integration, code or a partner, picking what gives the most value soonest.

• Integrate: build small integrations and improve the ones we have, so data moves reliably between Salesforce, Sage, YayPay, Snowflake and our other tools.

• Automate: workflows, manual steps and reports, using low-code and AI tools to move fast and checking their output carefully.

• Ship safely: test, document and hand over to support, so nothing depends on you to keep running.

• Land the change: plan training and communication, and follow up until the old way stops.

You'll love this role if...

• You have personally taken business problems from request to adopted solution, more than once, including outside your main platform.

• You have built or improved integrations between business systems: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, field mapping, matching and error handling, using integration or workflow tools.

• You are comfortable with SQL and data, and with low-code automation. Scripting or coding is a plus, not a requirement.

• You use AI tools to analyse, prototype and build, and check their output before it is used. You take responsibility for the quality and safety of what ships.

• You understand data: IDs, duplicates, sync and what makes a number trustworthy.

• You work directly with non-technical colleagues, challenge confidently and explain simply.

• You care about production discipline: version control, testing, security and documentation.

Nice to have: Salesforce, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform, Snowflake, Sage or HubSpot; experience in a consultancy, a scale-up or a small internal systems team where you wore several hats. Benefits

• Salary between £65,000 and £80,000 depending on experience

• Remote role with occasional travel

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

• Private healthcare including optical and dental cover and an online GP service

• Life insurance
